result.paraphrase: Gigabyte GTX 1050 Ti OC 4G graphics card. The WINDFORCE 2X cooling solution pairs two 80 mm unique blade fans with a semi-passive 3D active fan to provide efficient heat dissipation for better performance at lower temperatures. The 80 mm unique blade fan design splits airflow at the triangle fan edge and channels it smoothly through the 3D stripe curve on the fan surface, improving airflow. The semi-passive 3D active fan stays off when the GPU is below a set load or temperature for low-power gaming, letting users play in complete silence when the system is light or idle. With one-click Super Overclocking in the XTREME Engine utility, gamers can easily tune the card for different gaming needs without overclocking experience, avoiding manual adjustment. Ultra Cooling lower RDS(on) MOSFETs are designed to reduce switching resistance for faster charge and discharge of electric current at extremely low temperatures. Low Power Loss metal chokes retain energy longer than common iron-core chokes at high frequency, reducing core energy loss and EMI interference. Longer Life lower ESR solid capacitors improve electronic conductivity for better system performance and extended lifespan. Powered by GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, with 4GB GDDR5 128-bit memory, WINDFORCE 2X blade fan design, and support for up to 8K display at 60Hz.
